column1: For games that are not Flatpak, linux-reshade needs two things: the Vulkan layer installed for your user and the daemon running (it compiles the effects of open games and registers the shortcuts). After installing the layer, turn it on in a game with LINUX_RESHADE=1 in its launch options.

column1: Turn the effect on or off

Turns linux-reshade on for all Flatpak apps at once, like Flatseal's global setting: it installs the layer extension for every runtime version in use and grants the permissions in the global configuration. To leave out a single app, use "Turn off for this app" on the Flatpak games page, or set the environment variable LINUX_RESHADE=0 on it in Flatseal.
column2: Liga o linux-reshade em todos os apps Flatpak de uma vez, como a configuração global do Flatseal: instala a extensão da layer para cada versão de runtime em uso e libera as permissões na configuração global. Para tirar um app só, use "Desligar neste app" na página Jogos Flatpak, ou, no Flatseal, a variável de ambiente LINUX_RESHADE=0 nele.
